review_evidence: README states the project provides declarations and C thunks for GLFW/OpenGL access from Lean, with build instructions tied to native GLFW/Windows SDK paths.

All five primary Lean files were inspected. src/GLFW.lean and src/GLFW/OpenGL.lean are extern/FFI declarations and OpenGL constants/enums; src/Main.lean and tests/triangle_01.lean are rendering demos; lakefile.lean builds/links C/GLFW/GDI native objects.
No theorem, lemma, axiom, mathematical specification or proof-development surface exists independently of the graphics binding/demo role.
